subject: social_studies
concept: Applying political systems, economic systems, geography's influence, liberty/welfare tradeoffs, and safety net analysis to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student designs a hypothetical society's system, balancing political, economic, and welfare choices
exercise.abstract: Student explains their design's tradeoffs, referencing at least two concepts from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: design connects to at least two genuine unit concepts with explained tradeoffs
misconception_flags: design presents choices with no acknowledgment of any real tradeoff involved

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
